_comment: Facts a correct handling of this call has to reach the caller. End-state
checking cannot see any of them: the referral row is byte-identical whether
or not the agent explained that approval is not what earns the bonus, quoted
the qualifying window, or admitted it cannot look at the referred customer's
spending. This is a call about why nothing has happened yet, so almost all of
the value in it is in what gets said.
Each entry is satisfied when any one of its surface forms appears in the
agent's utterances, matched case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed.
A form that is a single number or a single word is matched on boundaries; a
form of two or more words is matched as a plain substring. That is why bare
figures like '15' are listed: '15' will find "15 USD", "15.00 dollars" and
"a total of 15", but will not match '$150', so an agent that quotes the wrong
amount gets no credit. Bare words are fenced for the same reason - 'two' must
not be found inside 'network'. Anchors are only ever the whole value: 'five'
is not listed for 95, since "five business days" would then satisfy a fee.
The alternatives exist so an agent is not failed for saying 'two billing
cycles' instead of '2 billing cycles'. Every form is a distinctive multi-word
phrase; nothing here would match an arbitrary transcript.
Requirements already asserted against the database are deliberately not
repeated. The tracker session against ce7d58b0-b5fc-42cb-a6e0-7a57929e1205, the secure-message notification
and the referral staying at approved / purchase_pending on the $100 offer are
all checked as state, so restating any of them here - including the offer
amount - would only double-count them.

required.why: the caller's whole complaint rests on believing his sister's approval earned the bonus; unless that is corrected he leaves the call still expecting money that is not coming yet and calls back for the same reason
any_of: approval on its own does not
approval does not release the reward
approval does not earn the reward
approval is not the thing that pays

required.why: the bonus depends on a qualifying purchase landing inside a fixed window, and he is the one who will pass that on to his sister; without the window he cannot tell her whether there is still time

he called because it feels slow, and the honest answer is that the reward can lag the qualifying purchase by up to two billing cycles; he needs the interval to know when it is genuinely worth calling back
he keeps asking whether his sister actually bought anything, and the agent genuinely cannot look; saying so is both the privacy boundary and the reason the agent cannot simply resolve his question
any_of: not able to see what she has spent

required.why: he is one sentence away from telling his sister to apply again, which would create a duplicate application and a worse problem than the one he called about; this is the only actively harmful thing he might go and do
